title: Medical Adjudicator
description:
Job Summary
Responsible for evaluating and processing medical insurance claims accurately as per policy terms, medical protocols, and company guidelines.
Key Responsibilities
•
Review and process OPD/IPD claims as per policy terms and SOPs
•
Validate medical necessity, exclusions, co-pay, and documentation
•
Coordinate with hospitals, providers, and internal teams for claim resolution
•
Ensure claim accuracy, TAT adherence, and IRDAI compliance
•
Maintain claim records, audit trails, and reports
•
Travel to Neyveli once a month for client meetings and discussions
Required Skills
•
Strong understanding of health insurance claims and medical terminology
•
Good analytical ability and attention to detail
•
Strong communication and coordination skills
•
Knowledge of TPA systems and claim processes preferred
Preferred Qualifications
•
Any AYUSH Doctor (BAMS / BHMS / BUMS / BNYS)
•
1+ years of experience in health claims adjudication with TPA/Insurance industry
•
Experience handling corporate and retail health insurance claims
Why Join Us?
•
Opportunity to work with leading corporate clients
•
Career growth in health insurance domain
•
Collaborative and professional work environment

title: Senior Recruiter – IT & Non-IT
description:
Job Description – Non-IT Recruiter
📍 Location: Noida Sector 3
🏢 Company: RAPS Consulting
🕒 Experience Required: 2–5 Years
About the Role
RAPS Consulting is looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Non-IT Recruiter with prior experience in Insurance/BFSI hiring. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in hiring insurance-related processes and a strong understanding of the insurance domain.
Key Responsibilities
  • Handle end-to-end recruitment for Non-IT Insurance/BFSI roles
  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, and references
  • Screen and shortlist candidates based on client requirements
  • Coordinate interviews and manage stakeholder communication
  • Maintain candidate pipelines and recruitment trackers
  • Understand hiring requirements and deliver quality profiles within timelines
Required Skill Set
Candidates should have prior hiring experience for processes such as:
  • Insurance Claims
  • Employee Benefits (EB / Non-EB)
  • Corporate Insurance
  • Group Life Insurance
  • General Insurance
  • GMC (Group Medical Coverage)
  • Commercial Lines
  • TPA operations
  • Underwriting / Servicing roles
Preferred Candidate Profile
  • Experience in Non-IT recruitment
  • Prior BFSI / Insurance hiring exposure
  • Good understanding of insurance terminology and processes
  • Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn and job portals
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced recruitment environment
Preferred Background
Candidates from:
  • Insurance recruitment firms
  • BFSI staffing companies
  • Insurance companies
  • Broking firms
  • TPAs
